source.note: The reverse of the Duryoga of v. 70: the lords of the sixth, eighth and twelfth each weak or combust in those houses, and the lords of the first, fourth, ninth and tenth each strong in a kendra or a trikona (C471). Read from V. Subrahmanya Sastri's 1937 translation of Mantreswara's Phaladeepika, the Sanskrit checked in the same print.

outcomes.text: a king, fortunate, wealthy, happy and virtuous
